snippet.title: Duck Life: Treasure Hunt Trailer
snippet.description:
Run, jump and fly through the hazardous ancient cave as you try and collect as much treasure as possible in Duck Life: Treasure Hunt! 

Out now for iOS and Android

iOS: https://itunes.apple.com/app/id875625142
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.mad.duck_life_treasure_hunt
